newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Wickes received tentative bids.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Wickes received tentative bids.

text.p: Wickes Plc the troubled do-it-yourself retailer which launched a survival refinancing earlier on Thursday, said on Thursday it had recently received a number of tentative bid approaches.

The company is widely seen as a sitting bid target after being hit by accounting irregularities in the summer which led to a restatement of profits and the launch of a 53 million stg rights issue. Bill Hoskins, finance director, told Reuters "Tentative is a good word...we had a number of people get onto us and our advisers in the recovery process. We had preliminary conversations with more than one party."
